problem_record.problem_statement: Contemporary publishing websites are bloated with trackers, invasive paywalls, and sluggish JavaScript hydration. Readers need a fast, accessible, distraction-free technical publication with instant search, responsive typography, and zero tracking.

target_user.primary_persona: Software architects, systems engineers, and technical researchers
target_user.context_of_use: Deep focused reading and architectural research across mobile, desktop, and low-light environments

constraints: Zero-Client-JS default reading performance: Semantic HTML/CSS ahead-of-time rendering.
Zero external network tracking: No third-party ads, telemetry, or remote beacons.
WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility: Keyboard-navigable, high-contrast, screen-reader friendly.
SEO & Syndication readiness: Schema.org TechArticle JSON-LD, Breadcrumbs, Sitemap, and JSON Feed.

market_feasibility.value_proposition: Distraction-free, zero-bloat technical journalism respecting reader cognitive bandwidth and privacy sovereignty.
market_feasibility.monetization_model: Open syndication via RSS/JSON feed with voluntary reader sponsorship demonstration.

mvp_scope: FEAT-01: Responsive Homepage with Category Navigation and Article Cards Grid
FEAT-02: Sub-5ms In-Memory Lexical Search Engine with Token Weighting
FEAT-03: Long-Form Editorial Article Reading View with Byline and Reading Time
FEAT-04: Tri-Theme Reading Mode Switcher (Light, Dark, Sepia)
FEAT-06: Schema.org TechArticle & BreadcrumbList JSON-LD Structured Data
FEAT-07: Sitemap.xml, Robots.txt, and JSON Feed 1.1 Syndication
FEAT-08: Newsletter Demonstration Form (prominently labeled local demonstration)
FEAT-09: Reader Feedback / Rating Widget (Domain M)
FEAT-10: Pre-Rendered Static HTML Pages for No-JS Web Crawlers
negative_scope_exclusions: EXCL-01: No third-party ad networks or tracking analytics
EXCL-02: No server-side authentication database or user paywalls
EXCL-03: No fake backend claiming server synchronization
